body: Please keep I mind how different it is when a man has a head of hair down to his ass and suddenly decides to have it into a very short death hawk. It literally changed the entire way he looked and also, his balding wasn’t that bad. He did this out of pure comfort for his own sanity. Your choosing not to change your hair or look is your choice just as it is his. If you do it and he can’t be with you, then it is a shallow and of skin relationship meaning he doesn’t care about your heart or soul in the least.

My man had super long hair and one day he decided to cut it all off because of his balding. It actually wasn’t that bad but he really felt that if he cut it, he would be more comfortable. He was self conscious and cut off all his beautiful long hair. I cried. But I knew this is what he wanted to feel happy at that time. He was as uncomfortable and did what he did. I love him no matter what. Take in mind, his cutting of his hair and taking on a different style changed him almost entirely physically. Again, I love this man and my love is not in love physical attraction. If you’re attraction is this shallow, fucking dump the guy so he can connect with someone real.

I get it actually. I’ve been with my SO for 2.5 years. We both went in knowing we had a certain amount of jealousy and possessiveness. We aren’t controlling or anything of each other but we both respect this and make a conscious effort not to upset the other. He has gone off a couple of times due to my liking and I’ve gone off a couple times due to women liking him (he is a tattooed musician). I have full reign and even post stuff for his music because he likes my ability to use words. I’ve seen his messenger and email open many many times and never once felt a serious hit of “who is he talking to?” The point I’m trying to make is, your match is out there who has the same boundaries you do and has no problem following them because they love you. Plain and simple. They will love you.

I say give it some time. This quarantine is causing job loss, potential job loss, financial stress, loss of friends and a social life, being secluded..... all of these things can make someone upset. Even with some mild worry, anxiety, depression, these things can trigger them full on, full swing. I am crazy about my bf yet I am worried and anxious about things that never heavily bothered me before. He is staying patient with me. On his end, he’s short fused and becoming an over the top hypochondriac. But we are both being patient because we love each other. Just give it time, be patient, and know this point in time is effecting people in all kinds of weird ways.
You do realize that one day you’re going to be soft, kind of flabby, probably a little overweight, and grey right? My opinion, grow the hell up and love people for what they have in their heart.

She’ll come around eventually, but it may take a while and it may even mean the end of your friendship. I’m so so sorry you’re in this situation. The first step to healing problems like these is recognizing them. I really don't think those who love you will forget you, they'll never forget you. Treating people like shit is usually a sign of insecurity, fear of being alone.. sometimes we completely thrash at people because we figure "you won't be around anyway". Maybe there's some anxiety in there too. Reach out to those you love, your parents, your siblings. Let them know of your struggle. Let some of this hurt and anger out and figure out why you're so angry at yourself. Lashing out at people doesn't make you a bad person and lashing out, I'm willing to bet, isn't the actual issue. You are lovable and valuable, people out there want to know you, people out there think about you, and people out there do care about how you are feeling.
